rule: Word-bounded TRAINING_CREDENTIAL_ followed by 12 to 32 uppercase ASCII letters or digits, in accepted event text fields only.
repair_invariants: same event IDs, order and surfaces
report_policy: Metadata only; no matched values, raw event text, paths or exception details in scan/error reports.
safety_scope: Only supplied synthetic local fixtures. No credentials, network, recursive scanning, provider validity checks, source execution or file writes.
limitations: Passing this rule does not establish real-secret detection, whole-repository coverage, credential revocation, full source assignment completion or production security.
